metadata.question: In Janaury 2020, did the city of Mahajanga experience more than 12 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Mahajanga, Madagascar (coordinates: ~15.62°S, 46.31°E) - Date range: January 2020 - Dataset: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Stations) - a commonly used precipitation dataset in GEE - Alternative: TRMM or PERSIANN if CHIRPS fails 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for CHIRPS precipitation data (it's already processed) - Focus on extracting mean monthly or cumulative rainfall 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero (B): Rainfall = 0 mm (legitimate no-rain scenario) - Invalid/Null (C3): Result is None, NaN, or out of realistic range (e.g., negative precipitation) - C1: If no data exists for January 2020 at Mahajanga - A: If cumulative rainfall > 304.8 mm (12 inches) - B: If cumulative rainfall ≤ 304.8 mm ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Mahajanga location const mahajanga = ee.Geometry.Point([46.31, -15.62]); const bufferZone = mahajanga.buffer(50000); // 50 km buffer for city area // 2. Define January 2020 time period const startDate = '2020-01-01'; const endDate = '2020-01-31'; // 3. Load CHIRPS precipitation data let col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(bufferZone); const imgCount = col.size().getInfo(); console.log('CHIRPS Images found (Jan 2020): ' + imgCount); if (imgCount === 0) { console.log('No precipitation data available for Mahajanga in January 2020.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Sum daily precipitation to get total monthly rainfall const monthlyRainfall = col.select('precipitation').sum(); // 5. Calculate mean rainfall over the city area (in mm) const stats = monthlyRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: bufferZone, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const rainfallMm = stats['precipitation']; console.log('Raw value check: ' + rainfallMm); if (rainfallMm === null || rainfallMm === undefined || isNaN(rainfallMm)) { console.log('Calculation failed or invalid result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 6. Validate: Check for unrealistic values if (rainfallMm < 0 || rainfallMm > 2000) { console.log('Invalid precipitation value: ' + rainfallMm + ' mm'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 7. Pixel count validation const pixelCount = monthlyRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: bufferZone, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const validPixels = pixelCount['precipitation'] || 0; console.log('Valid pixels: ' + validPixels); if (validPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid precipitation pixels in region.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 8. Convert to inches and compare const rainfallInches = rainfallMm / 25.4; const threshold = 12; console.log('January 2020 Mahajanga Rainfall: ' + rainfallMm.toFixed(1) + ' mm (' + rainfallInches.toFixed(2) + ' inches)'); console.log('Threshold: 12 inches (304.8 mm)'); console.log('Exceeded threshold: ' + (rainfallInches > threshold)); // 9. Final answer if (rainfallInches > threshold) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
